name: kb_386_Normalized

schema.description: GroupVersion contains the "group/version" and "version" string of a version. It is made a struct to keep extensibility.

groupVersion.description: groupVersion specifies the API group and version in the form "group/version"

version.description: version specifies the version in the form of "version". This is to save the clients the trouble of splitting the GroupVersion.

description: The API we are targeting belongs to the **apps** group and is versioned as **v1**, which together form the full group/version identifier **apps/v1**. For convenience, the standalone version string is simply **v1**, allowing client code to reference the version without needing to parse the combined group/version value.
